title: The Rivet Rain
text: The forge's ruined roof hangs overhead, a sky of rusted iron plates. Each time the wind blows through it, rivets come loose and fall like hail, hot from the sun and hard enough to crack a skull. The floor below is studded with them.

options.label: Dash across between gusts with your heads down.

outcomes.text: You make it across with a few dents in the helms.
A big gust brings down a hail of iron. Heads ring.

options.label: The sharpest times the wind, so you cross when the iron is still.

outcomes.text: You cross without a scratch and leave with a pocketful of rivets.

options.label: The strongest holds a door over everyone's heads, taking the hail themselves.

outcomes.text: The door rings like a bell all the way across, and their arms ring with it.
